releases.label: Expandable upgrade summaries
notes: Expand the new-version banner to review every available release before updating.
Show release history in stable build order, with accessible controls and a safe fallback when notes are unavailable.

releases.label: Consistent Recent Channels cards
notes: Keep Recent Channels cards at a consistent height and truncate message previews to one line, including long text and mentions.

releases.label: Faster scope switching
notes: Keep Deck scope changes responsive by reusing live local WApp and Recent Work data instead of refetching unchanged workspace projections.
Coalesce overlapping WApp update refreshes and avoid rewriting unchanged local WApp records during live activity.

releases.label: Reliable application updates
notes: Show immediate progress and prevent duplicate actions while an application update is being prepared.
Wait for a complete release and its service worker before reloading, with a bounded one-time recovery for stale assets.

releases.label: Automatic update completion
notes: Reload automatically when the verified new worker activates, including browsers that keep the same page controller.
Stop stalled update attempts within the configured limit and show an actionable retry state instead of remaining on Updating indefinitely.

releases.label: Local Inbox search and progressive loading
notes: Search the complete locally available Inbox as you type, including titles, card text, and older messages within chat threads.
Open the Inbox with the newest 50 matching cards and progressively reveal 50 more near the end of the list or with the accessible load-more control.

releases.label: Submit-only Inbox search
notes: Apply Inbox searches only after submitting the search field, so typing a draft does not change the visible cards.
Clear both draft and active Inbox searches when switching scope, restoring the newest 50 cards for that scope.

releases.label: Cleaner Inbox search field
notes: Remove the redundant visible Search Inbox label while keeping the search field accessible to assistive technology.

releases.label: Immediate Inbox search clearing
notes: Restore the full newest-first Inbox immediately when the search field is cleared, including with the native clear control.
Clear Inbox search and return to the first 50 cards whenever the selected scope or channel changes.

releases.label: Compact WApp Recents cards
notes: Open launchable WApp activity from one clear View action, preferring approved deep links and safely falling back to matching My WApps launchers.
Scan shorter WApp Recents cards with routine metadata hidden and read, dismiss, and mute controls moved into an accessible actions menu.

releases.label: Reliable application update activation
notes: Complete application updates reliably when multiple open Flight Deck tabs participate in service-worker activation.

releases.label: Stable live WApp Recents
notes: Render cached WApp Recents immediately from workspace-local data and update cards, unread counts, and mutes automatically as sync materializes changes.
Keep background reconciliation silent and avoid repeated WApp feed reads while live Tower updates are connected.

releases.label: Quieter profile relay defaults
notes: Stop connecting to relay.nostr.band for profile metadata while retaining the remaining profile relay fallbacks.

releases.label: Compact Inbox header
notes: Keep the Inbox title, search field, magnifier submit, and actions menu together on one responsive row, with New thread available from the actions menu.

releases.label: Efficient channel refresh
notes: Stop channel-directory refreshes from repeatedly downloading every channel's complete thread and message history.

releases.label: Faster local-first navigation
notes: Open cached channels immediately, refresh only the newest remote message page, and reuse recent channel refreshes.
Bound WApp Recents reconciliation so repeated live updates cannot continuously download the complete activity archive.
Reuse rendered Markdown and load the rich-text editor only when an editing surface opens.

releases.label: Working View actions for WApp Recents
notes: Show the View action on active WApp Recent cards when their own deep link is unavailable but a matching safe My WApps launcher is registered.

releases.label: Bounded live workspace refresh
notes: Process live Tower updates through their targeted local collection instead of repeatedly requesting the whole workspace delta.
Stop startup from crawling tasks, documents, files, and audio across every channel when those records are already materialized locally.
Load storage-backed document bodies only when a document is opened instead of downloading every document during list refresh.

releases.label: Compact reconnect catch-up
notes: Collapse large live-event replay bursts into one cursor-based workspace update instead of probing every historical task, thread, reaction, and document target.
Discard replay events already covered by a reconnect update so catch-up work is not immediately repeated.

releases.label: Reliable WApp Recent View actions
notes: Refresh the current user's My WApps launchers together with WApp Recents so View actions appear after a cold reload or stale local cache.

releases.label: WApp Recents on new devices
notes: Load WApp Recents and their matching My WApps launchers during first-time workspace setup, including browsers with an empty local cache.

releases.label: Bounded reaction refresh
notes: Fetch reactions only for chat messages and comments currently visible on screen, with duplicate refreshes reused for 30 seconds.
Stop requesting reactions for every workspace task and stop sweeping every channel when the task board opens.
Limit reconnect replay deltas so consecutive historical event batches do not repeatedly refresh the whole workspace.

releases.label: Stable current sync cursor
notes: Stop repeated SSE fallback syncs from requesting a workspace cursor that Tower has already confirmed is current.

releases.label: Clearer Inbox controls
notes: Keep New thread visible in the Inbox header, use a more compact search control, and label the search field Search Inbox.

releases.label: Tighter Inbox header
notes: Group the Inbox header controls consistently and simplify New thread to a compact plus button.

releases.label: Task mentions for agents
notes: Mention agents directly in task descriptions and task comments with the same selectable mention pills used in chat.
Send newly saved task assignments through Tower's typed assignment contract without retriggering unchanged assignments.

releases.label: Reliable task agent handoffs
notes: Mention agents directly in task descriptions and task comments with selectable mention pills that survive refresh.
Send newly saved task assignments through Tower's typed assignment contract without retriggering unchanged assignments.
Open task mentions and same-site task links reliably from chat, including tasks that need to be loaded before detail opens.

releases.label: Continuous task comments
notes: Keep a newly submitted task comment visible while Tower's task activity snapshot catches up, without showing a duplicate when the server copy arrives.

releases.label: Personal Deck and document agent controls
notes: Choose whether My Focus appears on the Deck from Setup; it now defaults to hidden and can be restored without changing Daily Scope data.
Mention agents in document comments and replies with the same selectable mention pills used elsewhere in Flight Deck.
Send document reviews to the default agent and inspect associated Autopilot sessions from the document actions menu.

releases.label: Reliable document agent routing
notes: Route full-document reviews with Tower's deterministic document trigger and open the exact document-bound sessions returned by Autopilot.

releases.label: Reliable live document comments
notes: See new document comments and inline replies automatically, without refresh or navigation replacing a newer discussion with an empty or stale view.

releases.label: Complete inline document conversations
notes: See replies to replies in document comment threads, including agent responses nested beneath a follow-up.

releases.label: Clearer document comment conversations
notes: Read every reply in a document comment conversation at one consistent indentation, including replies to replies.

releases.label: Denser text in Wingman on iPhone
notes: Fit more Flight Deck text on screen inside the Wingman iPhone app while keeping the standalone PWA layout and sizing unchanged.

releases.label: Unread channels first in All
notes: See unread channels first in the workspace All view with bold, high-emphasis labels, while scoped channel ordering stays unchanged.

releases.label: Feed dismiss controls
notes: Use the renamed Feed panel to dismiss one linkout card without opening it, or dismiss every item matching the current Feed filters from the options menu.
Keep dismissed Feed items cleared across refreshes through the existing server-backed item state.

releases.label: iPhone channel tab swiping
notes: Swipe the overflowing channel tab bar horizontally inside Wingman on iPhone while taps, tab menus, and header controls keep working normally.

releases.label: Responsive Feed dismissal
notes: See Feed cards disappear immediately when dismissing one or all matching items, with automatic restoration and clear feedback if the server cannot save the dismissal.

releases.label: Live Feed outstanding count
notes: See the Feed outstanding count update immediately when dismissing one or all items, including restoring the count if the server cannot save a dismissal.

releases.label: Persistent Feed dismissals
notes: Keep dismissed Feed cards and their outstanding count cleared after a full page refresh.

releases.label: Inbox-first mobile Deck
notes: Open the mobile Deck directly on Inbox, with Hello and Links one swipe to the right and Feed and Recent to the left.
Use four accessible Deck indicators while preserving the selected card through orientation changes and return navigation.

releases.label: Reliable mobile Inbox entry
notes: Enter the mobile Deck on Inbox every time from the workspace avatar's All view or a scope's Home view, without briefly showing Hello and Links first.

releases.label: Reliable return to channel Decks
notes: Return from a thread to the complete channel Deck without refreshing, with Hello and Links, Agents, and WApps still available.

releases.label: Reliable task return to channel Decks
notes: Return from a task through its channel link to the complete channel Deck, with Hello and Links, Agents, and WApps still reachable on desktop and mobile.

releases.label: Sticky mobile Deck headers
notes: Keep Inbox, Feed, and Recent titles and controls visible while scrolling their mobile Deck cards.

releases.label: Sequential chat catch-up
notes: Move through the chats visible in the current Deck list with Left and Right Arrow or deliberate horizontal swipes, without returning to the list between threads.
Use compact newer and older controls in the thread header, with navigation stopping at the visible list boundaries.

releases.label: Single-panel chat catch-up
notes: Navigate through any number of visible Deck chats in one thread panel, then close once to return directly to the original Deck list context.

releases.label: Reliable new direct messages
notes: Open direct-message creation from the DMs New control whether DMs Home or an existing direct message is selected.

releases.label: Reliable document uploads
notes: Upload valid DOCX files without a local database error, including when the browser omits their content type.
Choose a scope and channel before the upload dialog opens when Files has no channel context, with clear stage-specific failure details.

releases.label: Persistent personal agent lists
notes: Keep My Agents saved in Tower across refreshes and browser clients, while stale clients reload the newer list instead of clearing it.

releases.label: Reliable image paste routing
notes: Paste images and files into a Deck-opened message using that message's channel, even when the Deck itself has a different channel selected.
Keep the reply composer safely unavailable with a clear loading message until its channel context is ready.

releases.label: Durable agent activity
notes: Keep the newest agent turn visible when older completed activity is replayed, including after reconnecting.
Preserve current-work context with clear stale, reconnecting, and update-error states plus a removal control.

releases.label: Clearer pasted screenshots and reliable Deck return
notes: Insert numbered screenshot placeholders at the chat cursor when images are pasted, while retaining attachment thumbnails and upload handling.
Restore the complete responsive channel Deck after returning from a thread whose route hydration replaced the Deck markup.

releases.label: Inline pasted chat images
notes: Paste an image at any point in a chat message and keep it inline at that exact position after upload, while its attachment thumbnail remains available below the composer.

releases.label: Faster live agent replies
notes: Keep healthy live updates connected after background refreshes so completed agent replies appear promptly instead of waiting for the 15-second fallback poll.
Automatically retry live updates after a prolonged connection outage while preserving offline polling.

releases.label: Visible Agent Direct progress
notes: Show Agent Direct receipt and commentary updates in a thread opened from Deck, restore them after reconnecting, and clear the working state when the final reply completes.

releases.label: Agent thinking history
notes: Keep the latest Agent Direct thinking update concise and live, with an accessible second expansion for the full ordered thinking history that survives reconnects.

releases.label: Retry failed chat messages
notes: Resend your failed outgoing chat messages from their message menu while preserving the original text, mentions, and attachments.

releases.label: Reliable attachment resends
notes: Resend failed messages with fresh copies of their attachments, avoiding attachment ownership conflicts while preserving filenames, file types, and message links.

releases.label: Safe document saves
notes: Keep document edits open while pasted images upload, and return to Read mode only after the document save is confirmed.

releases.label: Preserve newly pasted document drafts
notes: Keep text and rich-content drafts intact when a newly opened document's background refresh finishes after editing has begun.

releases.label: Save the visible document editor
notes: Prevent duplicate rich-editor mounts from making Save read an empty editor while another visible editor contains your document.
Keep the visible draft open with an explicit error if editor serialization ever disagrees with the content shown on screen.

releases.label: Delegated WApp management
notes: Grant a person or agent narrow, expiring WApp management authority from Setup → Permissions, preview its limits before signing, and revoke it immediately.
Assign existing WApps through installation intents and inspect pending, active, failed, repairable, or revoked lifecycle state with reconcile and revoke controls.

releases.label: Stable comment reply drafts
notes: Keep long task and document comment drafts positioned at the current line while typing, and preserve a manually enlarged reply box instead of collapsing it on the next character.

releases.label: Reliable Feed links
notes: Open approved Feed View links at their complete destination, preserving query details and page fragments instead of falling back to the WApp root.

releases.label: Tower-approved Feed destinations
notes: Open a Tower-approved Feed destination immediately, including its query and page fragment, even while the local WApp permission list is still loading.

releases.label: Quieter sidebar navigation
notes: Remove redundant unread dots from top-level sidebar destinations while keeping unread indicators on individual channels.

releases.label: Live-only agent activity
notes: Keep current agent working and thinking activity visible in blue while hiding stale, connecting, and failed activity cards.

releases.label: Faster Agent Direct threads
notes: Open cached Deck threads immediately from local data without waiting for a Tower refresh.
Apply normal Agent Direct activity updates incrementally instead of refetching the channel's full activity history for every update.

releases.label: Visible background catch-up
notes: Keep cached workspace content usable while Flight Deck receives and applies startup changes, with a compact progress message for updates lasting longer than 1.5 seconds.
Show a clear retry state if startup updating stalls instead of leaving the workspace looking frozen.

releases.label: Operator-neutral setup guidance
notes: Use neutral example hosts, project paths, and browser-identity guidance throughout setup and managed WApp activation screens.

releases.label: Resumable workspace startup
notes: Load large workspaces in bounded pages, keep each completed page after an interruption, and resume without clearing browser storage.
Stop stalled startup requests within 30 seconds and show a retryable Update stalled state.

releases.label: Stable paginated startup completion
notes: Complete the final workspace snapshot transaction without repeatedly reopening the Update stalled message.

releases.label: Faster channel switching
notes: Switch cached channels without briefly clearing the conversation or showing messages beneath the wrong channel heading.
Ignore late channel loads during rapid navigation and enrich the destination conversation after its first visible frame.

releases.label: Instant cached chat navigation
notes: Show cached channels and scope feeds immediately while local and Tower reconciliation continues after the first frame.
Keep recent chat presentation state bounded while preserving threads, pending messages, expansion state, and scroll restoration.

releases.label: Paint-first chat navigation
notes: Paint cached or pending channel and scope state before board, route, subscription, scroll, unread, and reconciliation work begins.
Copy recent click-to-state and click-to-paint timings from the unobtrusive chat timing control for desktop or mobile validation.

releases.label: Shared work context controller
notes: Route the shared scope and channel bar through one controller across Deck, Chat, Tasks, and Docs.

releases.label: Deck-first work context navigation
notes: Open Deck whenever the shared scope or channel bar selects a new work context, including selections made from Chat, Tasks, or Docs.
Paint the destination Deck context before cleaning up the previous section or refreshing recent changes, routes, subscriptions, and background sync.

releases.label: Reliable chat file attachments
notes: Attach Markdown and other non-image files directly to chat messages and new threads without a local database error.

releases.label: Expanded workspace navigation
notes: Browse every visible scope and channel in the expanded desktop sidebar while the primary navigation and workspace selector stay fixed.
Scroll long scope and channel lists inside the sidebar, then open any channel directly in its full Chat context.

releases.label: Deck-aware sidebar channels
notes: Open Deck when selecting a channel from the expanded sidebar, matching the shared workspace channel bar.
Show resolved participant names for direct-message channels in the expanded sidebar.

releases.label: Clear mobile Inbox header
notes: Keep Inbox cards hidden beneath the fixed Inbox and search header while scrolling on mobile.

releases.label: Scope Home sidebar links
notes: Open a scope's Home view in Deck by selecting its heading in the expanded sidebar, with clear keyboard focus and current-page feedback.

releases.label: Workspace overview sidebar link
notes: Open the whole-workspace Deck from a workspace avatar link above the expanded sidebar hierarchy, clearly separated from Setup.

releases.label: Sidebar channel unread state
notes: See unread workspace channels at a glance in the expanded sidebar with the same red dot and bold label used by the channel toolbar.
Open the whole-workspace Deck from the expanded sidebar's clearer View All control.

releases.label: Reliable Feed-only WApp activation
notes: Activate an existing WApp with Feed-only authority without requiring a channel destination.

releases.label: Responsive sidebar navigation
notes: Use the complete Home, scope, and channel hierarchy in the opened mobile drawer, with scoped channel creation and channel settings controls.
Keep one workspace navigation surface on desktop: the sidebar when expanded and the horizontal channel bar when collapsed.

releases.label: Permission-safe sidebar creation
notes: Show each scope's channel creation shortcut only when the current workspace permissions make creation available there.

releases.label: Clear mobile sidebar selectors
notes: Show labelled Deck, Chat, Tasks, Docs, and Files controls above the open mobile sidebar while keeping the existing scope, channel, and compact controls when it is closed.

releases.label: Correct expanded sidebar selectors
notes: Move the labelled Deck, Chat, Tasks, Docs, and Files picker into the horizontal top bar when the left column is open, leaving the column for workspace scopes and channels.

releases.label: Restore mobile Setup selector
notes: Reach Setup from the labelled horizontal section picker while the mobile left column is open.

releases.label: Show Setup in expanded picker
notes: Reach Setup from the labelled horizontal section picker whenever the left column is open, including laptop and desktop layouts.

releases.label: Reliable live-update authentication
notes: Keep live workspace updates connected when Tower verifies the complete stream URL, including the latest reconnect cursor.

releases.label: Cleaner Home navigation
notes: Show Home directly beneath the section navigation without an extra horizontal divider in expanded desktop and mobile sidebars.

releases.label: Instant document editing
notes: Open documents in TipTap immediately, preserve typing while edit access is acquired, and provide safe retry, copy, and discard recovery when access or versions conflict.

releases.label: Durable Agent Direct thinking
notes: Keep Agent Direct thinking and commentary visible through live-update disconnects, reconnect replay, and missed terminal events.

releases.label: Reliable document autosave
notes: Keep TipTap saves on the latest accepted document version so autosave cannot mistake its own successful update for an external conflict.

releases.label: Efficient live updates
notes: Keep healthy live-update connections on the normal heartbeat cadence instead of repeatedly reloading the workspace after each update.

releases.label: Correct document self-conflicts
notes: Accept each successful TipTap save as the new local edit base before live updates arrive, preventing a document from conflicting with its own autosave.

releases.label: Fast live-update reloads
notes: Resume live workspace updates from the browser's materialised Tower cursor on first reload instead of replaying the workspace history from the beginning.

releases.label: Inbox review and document editing fixes
notes: Mark unread review tasks done directly from Inbox, moving them to Done and clearing their unread state while leaving other Inbox read actions unchanged.
Keep rich Markdown list items stable across repeated document open and autosave cycles without accumulating visible escape characters.

releases.label: Completed tasks stay out of Inbox
notes: Keep done, archived, completed, and cancelled task updates out of Inbox even when they are the newest unread activity, while retaining completed tasks on the task board.

releases.label: Consistent Inbox and Feed cards
notes: Use the same thin border on all four sides of Inbox and Feed cards.

releases.label: Clear Inbox attachment actions
notes: Label Inbox attachments by their source and say whether they open a task, document, chat, or Files, so the visible action matches its destination.

releases.label: Reliable Nostr avatar fallbacks
notes: Replace unavailable Nostr profile images with stable initials across chat, threads, comments, assignees, and identity controls, then recover automatically when the profile URL changes.

releases.label: Background workspace update progress
notes: Keep long workspace updates behind an orange profile-avatar ring, with receive, apply, and page progress available from the profile menu without covering workspace content.

releases.label: Reliable Inbox task completion
notes: Keep completed review tasks visible in Inbox with read styling, and advance their read watermark through the authoritative completion activity so older task activity does not return unread.

releases.label: Safe long-document saves
notes: Refresh a clean open document from its newest complete Tower version before saving, so an older editor buffer cannot overwrite restored content.
Pause a document save if the editor cannot round-trip all semantic content, while still allowing valid intentional deletions.

releases.label: Complete storage-backed document loading
notes: Keep storage-backed document previews read-only until the complete body loads, preventing an inline preview from replacing or saving over the full document.

releases.label: Verified native Flight Deck update feed
notes: Package reviewed Flight Deck release-branch builds into deterministic, versioned archives with a stable compatibility manifest for WMAPP.

releases.label: Actor-aware Inbox attention
notes: Keep task updates and comments authored by the signed-in person from creating unread Inbox attention for that same person, while retaining other people's activity as unread.

releases.label: Reliable self-authored task closing
notes: Keep tasks closed by the signed-in person read in Inbox and channel attention through background writes, live hydration, and overlapping read-state refreshes.

releases.label: Recoverable document autosave
notes: Preserve document edits promptly in the browser and autosave them to Tower at a calmer interval, so reloads and interrupted body loads do not lose the draft.
Keep stale document edits usable as recovery versions with current-head details and optimistic promote or discard actions.

releases.label: Direct Messages first
notes: Place Direct Messages immediately below Home in the sidebar, ahead of scope and channel groups, on desktop and mobile.

releases.label: Responsive large workspace updates
notes: Keep typing and navigation responsive while large Tower workspace updates commit records and their sync cursor atomically in the background.

releases.label: Reliable single-client document saves
notes: Keep a normal document save in the Saved state when its own same-version Tower update hydrates, while preserving genuine stale drafts as recoveries.

releases.label: Responsive mobile mention typing
notes: Keep thread typing responsive after inserting a mention pill by searching suggestions only for a new editable @ query.

releases.label: Bounded startup recovery
notes: Stop repeated stale-asset refreshes after one automatic recovery attempt and show a stable retry screen without clearing local workspace data.

releases.label: Faster mobile chat drafts
notes: Keep mobile chat typing responsive as drafts and mention pills grow by avoiding duplicate composer scans, selection cloning, repeated mention-chip work, and unnecessary layout setup.

releases.label: First-class Blocked tasks
notes: Show Blocked as a normal task status across boards, filters, task details, quick actions, Inbox activity, and parent/subtask progress.
Move tasks into and out of a dedicated Blocked column while preserving board ordering and existing blocked task data.

releases.label: Responsive typing during workspace catch-up
notes: Keep chat typing responsive while a large workspace catches up by avoiding repeated sidebar projection when synced scopes and channels have not changed.

releases.label: Scope-aware Inbox read shortcuts
notes: Keep Inbox bulk-read shortcuts within the visible scope and its descendants, while preserving workspace-wide marking from All scopes.

releases.label: Faster large-workspace navigation and typing
notes: Keep workspace entry and chat typing responsive by bounding recent-activity work, reusing unchanged Deck projections, and committing composer drafts to reactive state only when needed.

releases.label: Branch chat from any message
notes: Start an independent chat thread from any message while keeping the conversation up to that point as read-only context for the new question.

releases.label: Cleaner branched chat composer
notes: Open new chat branches with a clean composer while still routing the first ordinary message to the inherited Agent Direct recipient.

releases.label: Reliable branched chat messages
notes: Keep newly sent messages visible in branched chats during delivery, agent work, background reconciliation, and later reopen or reload.

releases.label: Faster cached activity and large histories
notes: Chat, task boards, comments, overview and files now load bounded cached windows with controls for older activity.
Compatible Tower servers send incremental record updates; local edits stay recoverable when shared changes conflict.

releases.label: Recover sync after server rollback
notes: Resume compatible sync after a Tower protocol rollback while retaining cached records, pending edits and separate recovery cursors.

releases.label: Restore channel sync in native browsers
notes: Fix WebKit worker startup so channels and other workspace records sync without clearing cached data or pending edits.

releases.label: Inbox paging within the Inbox
notes: Start with 50 Inbox cards and load older activity from one button at the bottom, including older search results.
Keep Files paging in its own footer and channel navigation independent of activity paging.

releases.label: Inbox chat activity and type filters
notes: Restored cached chats in Inbox and kept Recent Channels current independently of Inbox history.
Filter Inbox by All, Chat, Task, Docs or Files, with scope and search applied before paging.

releases.label: Bounded Inbox history and cached upgrade
notes: Keep Inbox and Recent Channels responsive in large histories, with scoped activity indexes and explicit progress through older search candidates.
Preserve cached conversations, pending changes and drafts when upgrading activity indexes.

releases.label: Inbox conversation history
notes: Open Inbox chats with their own live conversation history and reveal older cached replies without depending on Inbox previews.
Load missing conversation history in explicit pages while preserving cached messages and pending changes.

releases.label: Conversation navigation follow-up
notes: Keep conversation activity subscriptions current when reopening a chat or switching between Inbox chats.

releases.label: Inbox thread read state
notes: Preserve marking an Inbox conversation read when its history loads independently of the Inbox preview.

releases.label: Live conversation edits
notes: Update rendered conversation replies reliably when a live edit changes an existing message.

releases.label: Preserve reopened conversation history
notes: Keep known inherited conversation history visible when reopening or refreshing a partial page, and preserve forward paging progress.

releases.label: Workspace connection recovery
notes: Keep your saved workspace and cached content when connection or signer verification fails, with an error explaining how to retry.

releases.label: Owner workspace creation
notes: Fix new owner workspace creation by sending your signed-in personal identity as the workspace creator.

releases.label: Workspace isolation
notes: Keep separate workspace caches for workspaces with the same owner, preserve cached data when switching, and ignore delayed results from a previous workspace.

releases.label: Workspace member reset
notes: Reset the previous workspace member directory immediately during workspace activation.

releases.label: Legacy local edit recovery
notes: Warn when an older workspace cache contains unsynced edits or saved drafts. Preserve the originals for manual recovery without copying or sending edits to an uncertain workspace.

releases.label: WApp image uploads
notes: Choose and preview an icon image in Add or Edit WApp, upload it publicly to Primal Blossom, and save its URL with your launcher. Upload errors can be retried without losing the form.

releases.label: Channels stay visible during startup
notes: Keep known channels visible while workspace navigation hydrates after an update. Honor access removals and isolate delayed responses from other workspaces.

releases.label: Dismissible recovery controls
notes: Review legacy local-edit recovery from the avatar menu and dismiss it on this device.
Choose Tower’s version to refresh the workspace and stop prompting about older drafts, while retaining the old cache as a fallback.

releases.label: Reliable bulk chat read
notes: Mark chats as read continues past unavailable threads and updates read indicators only after Tower confirms each batch. Failed requests preserve unread indicators.

releases.label: Restored Inbox chat unread indicators
notes: Unread chats and replies show their indicators again in All and Chat Inbox and Recent Channels. Reading a thread clears its indicator, and later incoming activity can make it unread again.

releases.label: Automatic read-marker reconciliation
notes: Read receipts now reconcile automatically without local-edit warnings. Existing read-marker warnings clear during sync, and missing shared text no longer appears as an access change.

releases.label: Reliable agent mentions and chat threads
notes: Agents load for mentions when entering chat, without opening settings, and stay isolated to the selected workspace.
Thread summaries no longer appear as duplicate messages. Sending and retrying preserve message identity, thread links and unsent reply drafts.

releases.label: Agents available in channel composers
notes: Channel and thread mention menus include current workspace agents immediately after the roster loads, without waiting for group settings.

releases.label: Document save and visibility fixes
notes: Saving accepts insignificant trailing prose spaces while preserving the document integrity guard and local drafts.
Docs searches the full cached workspace list, includes descendant scopes, and shows the active view with an All documents action.

releases.label: Document save round-trip correction
notes: Saving preserves ordinary paragraph spaces and formatting around punctuation across repeated reopen cycles, while accepting a single trailing list prose space and still rejecting content loss.

releases.label: Cleaner document view
notes: Removed the reference strip above document content so it no longer flashes after saving.

releases.label: Reliable saves after rich text edits
notes: Document saves preserve spaces at formatting and paragraph boundaries, including after typing beside bold text. Repeated reopens retain content and formatting, while the save guard continues to reject content loss.

releases.label: Read review tasks in bulk
notes: Mark all tasks as read and Mark everything as read now clear current activity on review tasks without marking them done. New activity still appears unread.

releases.label: Reliable agent working updates
notes: Working panels stay visible during connection loss and recover missed updates automatically. Finished runs keep their working history after refresh, with earlier updates and runs available on demand.

releases.label: Replies stay visible in open threads
notes: New replies stay visible while sending and after acceptance in open conversations. Delayed refreshes preserve replies, server echoes reconcile once, and completing a send after switching threads does not change the new conversation.

releases.label: Reply acknowledgements stay in their workspace
notes: Finishing a reply after switching workspaces now updates its original local conversation without adding messages or changing drafts in the new workspace.

releases.label: Scoped working-update recovery
notes: Working-update recovery keeps retry state with the displayed conversation. Loading an earlier finished run or switching channels cannot clear recovery warnings for the active conversation.

releases.label: Quieter retained agent activity
notes: Each agent now has one current activity panel per conversation, with older runs available under collapsed Earlier activity. Quiet updates use neutral wording; connection warnings appear only during recovery.

releases.label: Working history in the menu
notes: Chat and Inbox show only current working commentary. Open Menu → Working history & diagnostics for retained runs, earlier updates and connection details, even after work finishes.

releases.label: Compact mobile Inbox
notes: Inbox cards now keep context and time on one line, retain useful previews and message counts, and avoid repeating the chat title. Mobile cards use three compact content lines with accessible read/done controls.

releases.label: One-line Inbox toolbar
notes: The mobile Inbox header keeps its title, type filter, search, new-thread button and read menu together on one compact line.

releases.label: Expandable current working updates
notes: Current answers animate while working. Click or use the keyboard to expand full working updates for that turn, with live counts and earlier-update paging. Older runs and diagnostics remain in Menu.

releases.label: Paired Tower FIPS connection
notes: Flight Deck can use a manually paired Tower FIPS endpoint through the native WMapp bridge while preserving its workspace, local data and queued writes. Public HTTPS remains available.

releases.label: FIPS availability and recovery
notes: Unsupported clients show a clear FIPS message. Native worker recovery cancels old streams, retains queued writes and enforces a bounded request size.

releases.label: Visible Tower connection switch
notes: Choose Public HTTPS or FIPS in Setup Connection. Mesh addresses in the HTTP override show a recovery action; manual HTTP mesh endpoints are no longer upgraded to HTTPS.

releases.label: Connection recovery safeguards
notes: Keep the transport controls in step with the selected backend and prevent a misplaced mesh connection key from returning after workspace Tower recovery.

releases.label: Clarify workspace backend settings

releases.label: Pair FIPS with workspace identity

releases.label: Reliable new workspace onboarding
notes: New Tower workspaces open their local database before creating starter scopes and channels.
Workspace selection resets derived channel and thread context without interrupting onboarding.

releases.label: Keep mentions ready during workspace refresh
notes: Member and agent mentions remain available when workspace metadata refreshes while the roster is loading.

releases.label: Restore mentions after access changes
notes: Workspace sync reloads the permitted member directory after an access reset so people and agent mentions remain available.

releases.label: Remember Tower FIPS connections
notes: Flight Deck saves the Tower FIPS endpoint and identity locally, retaining them when switching to HTTPS so FIPS can be selected again after reload.

releases.label: Lock into a view

releases.label: Manage scopes and channels
notes: Rename channels in Channel settings. Scope actions stay onscreen and are reachable from desktop or mobile navigation, with scope-level permissions for rename and delete.
Deletion confirmations explain archiving and retained content. Deleted scopes clear their channels from navigation; rename and delete failures stay visible.

releases.label: Keep locked views at workspace Home
notes: Workspace Home and its avatar retain the locked Chat, Tasks, Docs or Files view and clear lower scope and channel context.
Context navigation cleans up the previous thread and waits for document cleanup before publishing its route.

releases.label: Keep chat drafts and images stable
notes: Image upload completion, failure and removal preserve intervening typing and selection, and update the originating draft after navigation.
Channel and thread navigation retain unsent text. Unchanged message HTML keeps hydrated images in place during document updates.

releases.label: Preserve short rich document saves
notes: Rich document saves preserve pasted nonbreaking spaces and tabs, plus continuation paragraphs and nested lists, without triggering a false preservation failure.
Manual save and autosave retain complete document content while integrity checks continue to protect against content loss.

releases.label: Keep empty parent list items intact
notes: Nested lists beneath an empty parent item reopen without duplicated text, preserving their structure during rich document saves.

releases.label: Lock views from the mobile bottom bar
notes: Keep Chat, Tasks, Docs or Files open while browsing scopes, channels and workspace Home using the grey lock beside the active mobile bottom-bar view. Tap again to unlock, or select another view.

releases.label: Read-only FIPS Drive
notes: Browse explicitly shared desktop folders by source in Drive, refresh cached listings, copy reference links, and save files through WM App with progress and cancellation. Private folders remain owner-only; workspace shares require membership.

releases.label: Drive access and lifecycle fixes
notes: Keep Drive links and folder refresh working through navigation and brief Tower outages; cancel transfers when access changes.

releases.label: Accurate Drive save outcomes
notes: Distinguish completed local saves, completed exports and dismissed export sheets, including cancellation after a save has finished.

releases.label: Load complete thread history

releases.label: Visible scope delete confirmation

releases.label: Shared folders in Files
notes: Show shared desktop folders inside Files below Tower files instead of as a separate Drive navigation item.

releases.label: Reliable scope archiving
notes: Archive scopes from WM App without clone errors while keeping the in-app confirmation and visible failure feedback.

releases.label: Verified shared folders in Files build
Scope channel permission defaults

Channel settings show scope default access alongside channel-specific overrides.

releases.label: Shared folder listing diagnostics
notes: Add copyable diagnostics for shared folder listing failures and show unavailable listings without guessing that the source host is offline.

releases.label: Polished Files layout
notes: Show Tower files and shared FIPS folders side by side with a collapsible shared-folder panel and independent scrolling for long file lists.

releases.label: Quieter avatar sync clashes
notes: Move local file sync clash status into the avatar sync menu and use Tower as the default version when resolving older local file metadata.

releases.label: Removed review banner

releases.label: Mobile FIPS files access

releases.label: FipsDrive navigation and media previews
notes: Navigate shared folders with clickable breadcrumbs, including nested folders. The collapsed panel is now labelled FipsDrive.
Preview supported images and small videos on demand. Shared files offer Download and Copy link, with clearer download failure messages.

releases.label: Compact mobile Files toolbar
notes: Compact the mobile Files toolbar so search, filters, source switching, and options stay reachable without pushing the file list far down the screen.

releases.label: Mobile task list default
notes: Open Tasks in list view by default on narrow mobile screens while keeping board view available and preserving explicit view links.

releases.label: Compact mobile Docs header
notes: Reduce wasted space above mobile document content while keeping document actions, breadcrumbs, scope, and comments switching available.

releases.label: Content-first mobile Files and Docs

releases.label: Mobile FipsDrive native requests

releases.label: Compact mobile task controls
notes: Move mobile task search, filters, tags, sort, and related controls behind a compact ellipsis menu so the task list appears sooner.

releases.label: Manage scopes footer link
notes: Move the Manage scopes action to the bottom of the left sidebar with a separator above it.

releases.label: Safer mobile FipsDrive requests
notes: Reject unsupported mobile FipsDrive request bridges before raw FIPS requests and show clearer diagnostics when the native Drive grant is missing.

releases.label: Mobile task add controls fit
notes: Tighten the mobile task add row so the Add Task input, Add button, and compact controls fit cleanly on narrow screens.

releases.label: WM App FipsDrive bridge compatibility

releases.label: Reliable scope and channel sync
notes: Refresh scopes and channels as required control-plane data during Tower PG startup and full sync so navigation appears without visiting Setup first.

releases.label: Unread channel shortcuts
notes: Show unread channels in a shortcut section at the top of the left sidebar while keeping each channel in its normal scope location.

releases.label: Independent document comment scrolling

releases.label: Rollback Inbox working pulse

releases.label: Cached Inbox working pulse

releases.label: Reliable refresh workspace restore

releases.label: Unread and active channel shortcuts

releases.label: Reliable Tower workspace listing

releases.label: Tower workspace cache recovery
notes: Let a fresh Tower workspace list restore workspaces hidden by stale device-local removal markers.

releases.label: Tower workspace request diagnostics
notes: Use the signed browser session, not a stale workspace key, when listing Tower PG workspaces and show the exact Tower list request details in the picker.

releases.label: Long task title wrapping
notes: Let long task names wrap cleanly in task cards, lists, detail headers, and task references while slightly reducing the title size only in cramped long-title cases.

releases.label: Compact kanban controls
notes: Compress desktop task-board controls into one owner row, keeping owner and frequent filters visible while moving sort, child scopes, read, and bulk actions into the task menu.

releases.label: Automatic offline chat resend
notes: Retry failed local chat sends automatically when Flight Deck reconnects, preserving mentions, attachments, and thread context without showing duplicate delivered messages.

releases.label: Background offline resend
notes: Keep offline chat resend recovery off the loading and typing paths, waking a bounded background retry only after degraded connection signals recover.
Show a compact Offline or Reconnecting header badge only when Tower PG connectivity is degraded.

releases.label: Scrollable scope management
notes: Move Manage scopes to the bottom of the scrollable scope and channel list so the workspace switcher stays focused on workspace changes.

releases.label: Wrapping task titles
notes: Wrap long task-detail titles while viewing and editing on laptop and mobile layouts, including URL-like text beside the activity panel.

releases.label: Mobile message Read aloud
notes: Read chat messages aloud with private, device-native speech controls on supported iPhone, Android, and desktop browsers.

releases.label: Recoverable document save failures
notes: Keep document drafts open and recoverable when Save is rejected or fails before reaching Tower.

releases.label: Focused Deck task cards
notes: Hide done and completed task cards from the Deck while keeping active task ordering and other task views unchanged.

releases.label: Reliable workspace startup
notes: Open the saved workspace cache before access checks and live updates begin so navigation and workspace updates recover normally after a clean refresh.

releases.label: Keep workspace data across refreshes
notes: Keep the selected workspace and its device-local scopes, channels, and other cached records when a routine Tower workspace discovery response omits it; only a separately verified missing workspace can remove its local cache.

releases.label: Durable Agent Direct status
notes: Keep each Agent Direct turn under its own message, including queued, working, stale, failed, and cancelled states with retained commentary.
Reconcile visible agent activity and separate runtime health at least once a minute, even while live updates remain connected.

releases.label: Resizable chat composers
notes: Drag the bottom edge of desktop channel and thread composers to make longer messages easier to review before sending.

releases.label: Reliable Inbox unread cards
notes: Keep new chat replies highlighted in Inbox until you open the thread or mark it read, even while an older local attention snapshot is refreshing.

releases.label: Restore unread Inbox messages
notes: Show new chat activity as unread after sync-protocol fallback, until you explicitly open the thread or mark it read.

releases.label: Instant cached workspace startup
notes: Show saved scopes and channels immediately after refresh while sign-in, access checks, and current workspace updates continue in the background.

releases.label: Clear finished agent status
notes: Remove obsolete Agent Direct status cards when work finishes or a newer turn supersedes them, while keeping current and queued activity visible.

releases.label: Release document edit access
notes: Release document edit access when you leave Docs or background the page, while preserving unsaved changes as a local recovery draft.

releases.label: Clear discarded document drafts
notes: After discarding a preserved document draft, reload the current Tower document and show whether editing is available or who currently holds edit access.

releases.label: Read-only Agent Space
notes: Connect signed Autopilot packages over native FIPS, choose multiple visible agents, and keep their cards across reloads.
Open read-only agent Overview, Pipelines, Schedules, and Triggers in Flight Deck, with a secondary link to Autopilot.

releases.label: Actionable native FIPS connection failures
notes: Connect signed Autopilot packages using their exact FIPS transport identity, and show the specific failed connection stage with a useful recovery action.

releases.label: Conversation card index
notes: Browse channel conversations as spacious cards with prominent titles, opening and latest messages, activity, and message counts.
Start new threads and edit messages in the established conversation modal instead of an inline channel composer.

releases.label: Save connected agents
notes: Save selected agents after signed Autopilot discovery and retain the verified connection package version across reloads.

releases.label: Finish connected-agent saves
notes: Finish saving selected Autopilot agents without leaking browser storage transaction errors, and offer a safe retry if local persistence is interrupted.

releases.label: Accurate reconnect status
notes: Clear Reconnecting after the active space recovers, and ignore delayed connection events or retries belonging to a previously selected space.

releases.label: Single-row mobile navigation
notes: Use clear icons for the mobile bottom navigation and keep every section on one horizontal row, with scrolling available on especially narrow screens.

releases.label: Reliable reconnect indicator
notes: Keep the active space online after successful sync when a previously failed message retry or background operation still needs attention.

releases.label: Controlled Autopilot restart
notes: Request an explicitly confirmed, admin-signed Autopilot restart directly over the verified FIPS connection and follow its recovery status across reconnect.

releases.label: Visible verified restart control
notes: Use controlled restart from the top-level Agents screen, with an explicit Autopilot target and a verified current capability check before the action is enabled.

releases.label: Restore paired live activity
notes: Refresh signed capabilities for existing paired Autopilots so compatible live thread activity starts without reinstalling agents, while Tower remains the fallback.

releases.label: Targeted membership updates
notes: Apply membership and access changes without a full workspace catch-up, and preserve agent identity, names, and profile photos when adding agents to groups or channels.

releases.label: Faster channel conversations
notes: Open channels with a compact conversation header and a bounded first page of conversation cards, while keeping older conversations available on demand.

releases.label: Reliable mobile thread replies
notes: Load the owning channel reliably when opening a thread from Inbox, keep failures retryable, and use a compact mobile reply composer with aligned actions.

releases.label: Scannable mobile task threads
notes: Show task thread titles in bold on mobile cards so the right conversation is easier to find and update.

releases.label: Compact thread controls
notes: Stack Menu above Start thread in the thread composer so the controls use less horizontal space.
Hide the reconnecting indicator on connected mobile sessions while preserving feedback during genuine connection recovery.

releases.label: Accurate mobile connection feedback
notes: Keep mobile connection and agent activity controls live when Tower fallback sync is usable during SSE recovery, while still showing reconnecting feedback after a real Tower failure.

releases.label: Independent FIPS service connections
notes: Keep Tower, Autopilot, live agent activity, and Drive connected through independent identity-pinned WMapp transport handles.

releases.label: Actionable Autopilot signing errors
notes: Preserve safe WMapp signer error codes and a correlation reference when an exact Autopilot request cannot be signed.

releases.label: Fast scope switching
notes: Open a searchable, keyboard-friendly scope grid from the command palette or the desktop and mobile scope controls.

releases.label: Numbered scope selection
notes: Select any of the first ten visible scopes with 1–9 or 0; numbered scope shortcuts follow the current filtered order.

releases.label: Compact agent status in chat
notes: Keep one current agent status per conversation alongside queued work and failures. Older statuses and commentary remain available in Working history & diagnostics.

releases.label: Keep workspace views visible during resync
notes: Keep cached scopes, channels, and messages visible while startup, refresh, and reconnect download replacement data. Reject incomplete responses and preserve access revocation and deletion.

releases.label: Recover mobile connection status
notes: Clear stale Reconnecting status after a successful workspace pull. Activity recovery errors no longer prevent fallback workspace updates; failed pulls and offline warnings remain visible.

releases.label: Keep earlier dispatch failures in history
notes: Show the current agent status and queued work without stacking earlier failed dispatch cards. Earlier failures remain in Working history & diagnostics; the current failure stays visible.

releases.label: Preserve rich pasted document drafts
notes: Save rich pasted drafts with leading, repeated and trailing line breaks, underlined links and overlapping italic formatting. Preserve those details on reopen and keep rejecting genuine content loss.

releases.label: Reduce avoidable sync errors
notes: Use actor signing in PG workspaces, retry superseded startup reads, and skip unadvertised session-health requests. Handle stale reaction targets without masking permission errors and remove duplicate editor links.
Keep transaction failures visible with worker diagnostics while bounding repeated console errors.

releases.label: Show existing Tower workspaces
notes: Show every returned workspace as a separate selectable row when several share an owner. Report fetched, mapped, and visible row counts in the connection diagnostic.

releases.label: Readable task comments
notes: Show paragraph breaks in task updates that arrived with escaped newlines, in both activity views. The comment composer now explains Markdown and fenced code boxes.

releases.label: Create Hosted Free workspaces
notes: Create a Hosted Free workspace from setup with your Nostr signer, see the 1 GB free allowance, and open it after signed verification. Retry interrupted signup without creating a duplicate workspace.

releases.label: Roomier Deck on phone and laptop
notes: Keep Inbox, Feed, and Recent channels controls visible while their cards scroll. On phones, the Deck fills the available screen and uses narrower gutters for Hello, WApps, and agents.

releases.label: Keep local navigation during sync
notes: Scope and channel refreshes keep local pending changes and cached navigation while workspace sync catches up.

releases.label: Preserve chat and navigation during catch-up
notes: Prevent ordinary multi-page sync from retiring cached scopes, channels and chats. Recover caches affected by earlier builds through one authorized snapshot while keeping current data visible until completion.

releases.label: Tidy Deck Feed and Recent Channels
notes: Feed and Recent Channels use more of the available width, with fixed opaque headings and independently scrolling lists on phone and desktop.

releases.label: Responsive snapshot sync and conversation loading
notes: Apply authorized sync pages progressively while keeping cached navigation and messages readable. Bound database transactions and resume interrupted snapshots without replaying the whole workspace at once.
Conversation history becomes ready independently of activity and session-health recovery. Preserve local edits, deletion handling and one-time snapshot reconciliation.

releases.label: Validate bounded sync replay
notes: Validate complete sync pages before applying their first batch, and keep interrupted delta retries usable as new remote updates arrive.

releases.label: Keep omitted edit recovery
notes: Keep a recovery copy and queued writes when a completed snapshot retires a previously authorized record whose view was refreshed through a targeted read.

releases.label: Subscribed feed reader
notes: Add an explicit Subscribed Feed view with authorised WApp discovery, direct-CORS public RSS/JSON sources and personal read, dismiss and save flags. Legacy Feed remains available.
Bound source fetching and parsing, isolate reader caches and purge private content on observed access loss. Source implementation requires coordinated Tower/WApp activation; no automatic migration.

releases.label: Preserve feed mutation conflict errors
notes: Reject reused feed mutation IDs without retrying. Reconcile personal feed flags only when Tower reports an authoritative state conflict. Source fix only; coordinated runtime activation remains separate.

releases.label: Recover Feed identity and app discovery
notes: Use your verified Tower reader identity when opening Feed, recover missing startup identity, and keep subscriptions isolated when switching accounts or workspaces.
Discover apps from existing Agents connections with per-connection HTTPS/FIPS choices and a styled feed picker with loading, retry and readable access or connection errors.

releases.label: Complete Feed startup recovery
notes: Recover the reader actor through the canonical saved-workspace store when startup metadata is missing, without changing the selected signer or workspace.

releases.label: Explain Feed source prerequisites
notes: Explain source graph-binding, reader access and unsupported transport failures in subscribed Feed, with actionable recovery steps.

releases.label: Finish Feed picker presentation
notes: Use consistent form borders, section dividers and loading feedback in the Add feed dialog on phone and desktop.

releases.label: Recover stalled workspace updates
notes: Recover expired sync cursors when reactive reader identity is passed to the background worker. Preserve cached navigation, history and local pending changes through interrupted recovery.
Reconcile acknowledged changes safely during snapshot catch-up and keep genuine update errors steady while automatic retries run.

releases.label: Isolate workspace retry status
notes: Keep update retry feedback scoped to the selected workspace and signer. Ignore late progress and errors from a previous workspace after switching.

releases.label: Keep Feed failures from blocking workspace updates
notes: Reconcile missing activity and workroom targets without blocking valid messages. Retain real errors and retry failed updates after connectivity recovers.

releases.label: Acknowledge review tasks without completing them

releases.label: Context Tree synchronization and cache adapters

releases.label: Balanced mobile Inbox toolbar

releases.label: Compact mobile Inbox Search

releases.label: Read-only scope Context Tree

releases.label: Context browser lifecycle recovery

releases.label: Local-first conversation content

releases.label: Inspect Autopilot pipeline runs
notes: Inspect actual pipeline steps, child workflows and attempt history from a verified Autopilot connection.

releases.label: Edit Context Tree components and references

releases.label: Clear primary navigation

releases.label: Clear pipeline connections and exact evidence
notes: Follow labelled connections between named ports, see bounded run previews, and inspect exact retained fields with a usable mobile inspector.

releases.label: Single-line mobile Inbox

releases.label: Verified pipeline ports and evidence navigation
notes: Follow actual named-port connections and bounded request, tweet, response and delivery previews.

releases.label: Clear Context Tree loading failures
notes: Report a missing Context Tree backend route as a load failure, while preserving neutral access denials and management-only editing.

releases.label: Bounded pipeline records and actual port previews
notes: Browse every retained record with render pages, search all loaded records, and copy exact single or complete values.

releases.label: Reliable Context Tree recovery
notes: Share workspace recovery when opening Context Tree during updates, and reload acknowledged edits after the current snapshot finishes.

releases.label: Pipeline viewer activation control
notes: Keep the pipeline viewer pending activation until its compatible Autopilot backend is ready.

releases.label: Polished Context Tree

releases.label: Context Tree reference results
notes: Keep reference-search empty states accurate while showing matching accessible records.

releases.label: Context Tree keyboard finishing touches
notes: Fit searched components at readable zoom and return focus to the canvas when deletion removes the dialog opener.

releases.label: Context Tree focus restoration
notes: Restore keyboard focus after the browser closes a component dialog, including after confirmed deletion.

releases.label: Pipeline evidence redaction review
notes: Withhold cached pipeline evidence and selectors when the service requires credential redaction review. Keep unrelated connection conflicts recoverable.

notes: Manage scopes and channels in one compact list. Edit scope details and people, agent and group access together in the scope modal.
